name: CRE32
source: CRE benchmark problems (Tanabe & Ishibuchi, 2020). 8 constrained multi-objective problems with explicit constraints. Reference: Ryoji Tanabe, Hisao Ishibuchi, "An Easy-to-use Real-world Multi-objective Problem Suite" Applied Soft Computing. 89: 106078 (2020) Note: Original reproblems use g >= 0 = satisfied. BOCoDe uses g <= 0 = satisfied. Constraints are negated accordingly.
